title: Hence no sufficient grace for those who do not believe
source_text: XLIV. Proinde cum illa Dei operatio in iis sese non exerat qui reipsa non credunt & poenitentiam agunt, idcirco qui isti Synodo subscribunt Theologi, negant illis gratiam sufficientem dari, quantumcunque externa verbi praedicatione ad poenitentiam & fidem invitentur, & quibusdam etiam internis Spiritus Sancti motibus percellantur.
pass_a_gloss: XLIV. Accordingly since that operation of God does not exert itself in those who in fact do not believe & repent, therefore the Theologians who subscribe to that Synod, deny that sufficient grace is given to them, however much they are invited to repentance & faith by the external preaching of the word, & are struck also by certain internal motions of the Holy Spirit.
pass_b_english: Thesis XLIV. Since that working of God does not show itself in those who do not actually believe and repent, the theologians who subscribe to that Synod deny that such people are given sufficient grace, however much the outward preaching of the word invites them to repentance and faith, and even though some inward motions of the Holy Spirit stir them.
